hook: Miss *Nov 30* and your trade licence costs 25% more
hook_b: Miss *Nov 30* and your trade licence costs 25% more
tldr: Cyberabad Municipal Corporation wants all trade licences renewed for 2027 by November 30, 2026, or penalties kick in.

beats.what: CMC Commissioner G. Srijana announced renewal of existing trade licences for Jan 1 to Dec 31, 2027.
beats.why: Renewals from Dec 1, 2026 to Jan 31, 2027 attract a 25% penalty under the applicable provisions.
beats.care: Shop and business owners in CMC limits pay more for every month they delay.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: CMC has started generating renewal demands and will send SMS alerts to traders.

cards.q: If you run a business, have you renewed your trade licence yet?

qs: How many traders in CMC limits hold licences due for renewal?

viz.verdict: Delay costs traders more the longer they wait.

cover.label: Last day to renew without penalty

watch: SMS renewal demands from CMC to traders in the coming days.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: CMC sets November 30 deadline for trade licence renewal

fact: Cyberabad traders who miss the *Nov 30* licence renewal face a 25% penalty
twist: Renew on or after *Feb 1, 2027* and the penalty doubles to 50%.
